hotel: Tower Club at lebua, on the 61st floor of State Tower
bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck for parties of up to six, or by phone, WhatsApp or Line. A deposit of THB 3,000 secures each booking and comes off the final bill; the booking isn't confirmed until it's paid. Dinner is served Tuesday to Sunday from 5:30pm, with the last booking at 9:30pm.
cancellation: Bookings can be changed or cancelled free of charge up to 72 hours ahead. Later cancellations, changes and no-shows lose the THB 3,000 deposit. Special event nights (Christmas, New Year's Eve, Valentine's Day, wine dinners) need a 100% non-refundable deposit.
waitlist: When a time is full, TableCheck offers a waiting list and the restaurant gets in touch if a table frees up.
groups: Parties of more than five book through the dining reservations team (dome@lebua.com) and pay a 100% non-refundable deposit in advance.
dressCode: Smart elegant. Men need a collared shirt and long trousers (long jeans are fine with covered shoes); no T-shirts, sleeveless tops, shorts, caps, sportswear, swimwear or flip-flops. Women may wear tailored shorts and dress sandals.
children: Children aged 7 and over are welcome with an adult, and the dress code applies to them too.
byob: Corkage is THB 2,500 plus service and VAT for a 750ml bottle (THB 5,000 for a magnum); outside wine isn't allowed on special event nights.
